title: Eglin Daily No. 053 — Second return-to-cadence in 9 days; Ashby MCP verified; iCIMS Intelligent Hiring Platform
summary: Daily Signal Brief for 2026-09-02. Second consecutive return-to-cadence after a 9-day / 7-business-day silent gap post-8/24 — the operational fire-cadence fix the 8/24 brief asked for did not land; the L3 signal repeats verbatim and escalates to L4 if Thursday 9/03 does not fire (Signal 01). Material net-new from the gap is competitive, not regulatory: Ashby MCP Server confirmed at primary source (Open Beta 29 June 2026, all Ashby plans, ChatGPT/Claude/Cursor clients) — 8/24 verify-flag discharged; TA-lane MCP-adopter count moves from two (Greenhouse + Workable) to three (add Ashby), probably four with HiBob's April 2026 beta MCP server pending verification; iCIMS unveiled Intelligent Hiring Platform in-window with a Hiring Agent shipping October 2026 and Interview Scheduling Agent end-of-2026 — TA-lane agentic-ATS posture Compass /compare and Vector should absorb this week (Signal 02, L2). Article 50 gains a second date: beyond the 2 December 2026 machine-readable-marking anchor, a further deferral to 2 February 2027 applies to watermark-detection interoperability under Article 50(2), and the Code of Practice requires at least two machine-readable techniques per output — Kernel v1.3 split-probe scope should move from two tracks to three; Compass paragraph swap names both dates explicitly (Signal 03, L2). Mobley durability holds passively at D+72/D+52 post-Lin's 22 June order. O-2 self-check names two misses on the record: the 2 February 2027 deferral was in force before 8/24 and Eglin should have surfaced it then; WebFetch on the Ashby primary-source URL was blocked by network egress and Eglin fell back to WebSearch summarisation without escalating the egress block as its own operational signal.
